residual_risks.R2: External effects are not crash durable or universally exactly-once.
residual_risks.R3: Persistence is best effort and every replayed transaction re-enters validation.
residual_risks.R4: Process OOM abort, FFI failure and memory corruption are outside the tx-pool model.
residual_risks.R5: Derived template failure can retain the last valid template and underfill until a source change.
residual_risks.R6: Optional replacement history can be discarded as a complete set under its bounded sub-budget.
residual_risks.R7: Legacy v1 persistence remains an accepted compatibility input.
residual_risks.R8: Peer-ban fence saturation evicts the oldest fence; a delayed submission from that session must re-enter full bounded validation.
